text:
Maya Singh: Heads-up: Celestia Systems wants a joint "micro-to-max" throughput vs energy run next Thurs/Fri. They care most about tokens/sec per watt and steady-state tail-latency at 95/99. Scope propose: three models (tiny, base, longform), seq lens 128/1024/4096, batch sweep [1,4,16], power hooks for wall and board PMUs. Need partner lab checklist and a reproducible artifact. Who can own the runbook edits?

Ravi Patel: I'll update the runbook and make a checklist. For kernel knobs we should try: `tickless_idle=0`, `hw_prefetch=off`, and `cpu_governor=performance` on partner nodes. Also try two compiler flags: `-O3 -funroll-loops` vs baseline. I'll push a branch `celestia/bench-tweaks` and a docker image `ghcr.io/redwood/celestia-bench:v1`.

Tom H.: I'll coordinate the testbeds: `lab-cel-01` (onsite) and `celestia-remote-2` (partner VPN). Upload path: `s3://redwood-evals/celestia/micro-max-2026/`. Please follow this CSV layout so downstream ETL can ingest easily:
```
id,model,seq,batch,tokens_s,energy_joules,avg_power_w,tokens_per_joule,latency_p95_ms,latency_p99_ms,cpu_governor,kernel_flags,container_sha,notes
```
Include `energy_joules` (we prefer integrating power over run). Add `sample_rate_s` as a comment in the notes if not explicit.

Maya Singh: Nice. Add tags to artifacts: `partner=celestia`, `campaign=micro-max-1`, `bench_owner=ravi`. Can the infra team expose PMU mountpoints to the container?

LabBot: PMU mountpoints `/sys/class/powercap/` and `/dev/pmu0` will be bind-mounted when the image runs with `--cap-add=SYS_RAWIO` and `--device=/dev/pmu0`. Make sure CI policy allows `SYS_RAWIO` for these runs.

Ravi Patel: Sample run command for partners:
```
./bench_runner --model base --seq 1024 --batch 4 --duration 300 --power-sample 0.5s --out s3://redwood-evals/celestia/micro-max-2026/$RUN_ID/
```
Require they upload `power.csv`, `tokens.csv`, `dmesg.log`, and `container_sha.txt`. We'll compute `tokens_per_joule` offline as `total_tokens / total_energy_joules`.

Tom H.: I'll schedule two smoke slots this week for remote validation. Also adding a short checklist to the Jira: PRJ-2984. Please ensure bastion key in `vault/partners/celestia/keys`.

CI-Bot: CI job `bench/validate-schema` added to pipeline. It will fail if CSV headers mismatch.

Maya Singh: Acceptance criteria proposal: prefer configurations where tokens_per_joule improves >=7% and p99 latency doesn't increase by more than 8%. If energy improves but p99 increases >8% escalate to SRE. For marketplace notes, we'll need a short blurb <150 words and a single chart: tokens/sec per watt vs seq len.

Ravi Patel: I'll produce the first-pass analysis + a 3-slide deck. Also watch for thermal throttling: ask partners to capture `thermal_zone*/temp` every 10s.

Maya Singh: Thanks team. I'll ping Celestia contacts and attach the runbook link in the Jira. We'll iterate on the exact prompt set (partners want private prompts + our public subset).
